Class RepositoryFactory

java.lang.Object
repository.RepositoryFactory
public class RepositoryFactory extends Object
Selects repository implementations from src/main/resources/config.properties relative to the working directory. Reads configuration once per factory. MEMORY ignores validators; FILE passes them to repositories that load immediately; DATABASE creates placeholders and does not open a connection. The repository type and file paths are trimmed. Database connection settings are passed to constructors without trimming.

  • Constructor Details

    • RepositoryFactory

      public RepositoryFactory()
      Loads properties and selects the case-sensitive repository.type. Other settings are checked when creating the corresponding repository.
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the configuration file cannot be read or closed
      IllegalArgumentException - if the type is missing, blank or unknown, or the properties file contains a malformed Unicode escape

  • Method Details

    • createUserRepository

      public UserRepository createUserRepository(Validator<User> validator)
      Creates a new user repository for the configured storage type. FILE requires a nonblank users.file. DATABASE requires nonblank db.url and db.user, and a present db.password (an empty password is accepted).
      Parameters:
      validator - the user validator; required only for FILE, ignored by MEMORY and merely stored by DATABASE
      Returns:
      a new empty MEMORY repository, immediately loaded FILE repository, or unimplemented DATABASE repository
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a required setting is missing or blank, or the configured file path is invalid
      NullPointerException - if FILE is selected and validator is null
      RepositoryException - if a FILE repository cannot read its data

    • createFriendshipRepository

      public FriendshipRepository createFriendshipRepository(Validator<Friendship> validator)
      Creates a new friendship repository for the configured storage type. FILE requires a nonblank friendships.file. DATABASE requires nonblank db.url and db.user, and a present db.password. The caller supplies a validator linked to the appropriate users, if needed.
      Parameters:
      validator - the friendship validator; required only for FILE, ignored by MEMORY and merely stored by DATABASE
      Returns:
      a new empty MEMORY repository, immediately loaded FILE repository, or unimplemented DATABASE repository
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a required setting is missing or blank, or the configured file path is invalid
      NullPointerException - if FILE is selected and validator is null
      RepositoryException - if a FILE repository cannot read its data
